zh-CN.accounts.confirmStop.title: 停止这个账号？
zh-CN.accounts.confirmStop.body: 停止后，这个账号不再自动务农，直到再次启动。
zh-CN.accounts.wxLoading: 正在获取微信登录二维码
zh-CN.accounts.wxScanned: 已扫码，请在手机上确认
zh-CN.accounts.wxAuthorized: 已确认，正在建立登录会话
zh-CN.accounts.confirmDelete.title: 删除这个账号？
zh-CN.accounts.confirmDelete.body: 删除后，这个账号的本地登录信息不再保留。
zh-CN.accounts.confirmClear.title: 清理已停止的账号？
zh-CN.accounts.confirmClear.body: 将删除 {count} 个已停止的账号。正在运行的账号不会动。删除后，这些账号的本地登录信息不再保留。
zh-CN.accounts.cleared: 已清理 {count} 个已停止的账号
zh-CN.config.title: 游戏配置

zh-CN.config.delete.title: 删除这条配置覆盖？
zh-CN.config.delete.body: 只去掉本地覆盖。没有覆盖时，官方配置保持不变。
zh-CN.config.plantSearch: 按植物名称或编号查找
zh-CN.config.number: 数字字段必须是不小于 0 的整数。
zh-CN.config.needPlant: 请选择一个有效的关联植物。
zh-CN.config.imageFormat: 图片格式仅支持 PNG、JPG 和 WebP。
zh-CN.dashboard.title: 总览
zh-CN.dashboard.empty: 先从账号里选择一个农场。
zh-CN.dashboard.name: 昵称
zh-CN.dashboard.forecastPlots: 已种植 {plots} 处 · 预计 {exp} 经验
zh-CN.dashboard.forecastManual: 收获时间取决于手动操作或恢复自动农场
zh-CN.dashboard.mixedRate: 收获排期 + 历史均值
zh-CN.dashboard.earlier: 还有 {count} 条更早的日志
zh-CN.dashboard.confirmClear.title: 清空运行日志
zh-CN.dashboard.confirmClear.body: 只清空这个账号的运行日志。
zh-CN.farm.title: 我的农场
zh-CN.farm.needRunning: 先启动这个账号，地块和操作才会出现。
zh-CN.farm.confirmRemove.title: 铲除这块农场上的作物？
zh-CN.farm.confirmRemove.body: 铲除会清掉当前作物，这个操作不能撤销。
zh-CN.farm.fertNeed: 请先选择要施肥的土地
zh-CN.farm.fertLimit: 一次最多选择 64 块土地
zh-CN.farm.confirmFertilize.title: 给这些地施肥？
zh-CN.farm.confirmFertilize.body: 只会给仍在生长的选中作物施肥。选中合种副地时改施主地。
zh-CN.farm.careNeed: 请先选择要务农的土地
zh-CN.farm.confirmCare.title: 给这些地务农？
zh-CN.farm.confirmCare.body: 只会处理缺水、有草、有虫或需要清理互动道具的选中作物。选中合种副地时改处理主地。
zh-CN.interaction.empty: 背包中暂无可对自己农场使用的特殊互动道具
zh-CN.interaction.needLands: 请先填写地块编号，例如 1,2,3
zh-CN.interaction.confirm.title: 使用这个互动道具？
zh-CN.interaction.confirm.body: 道具会按编号用到选中的地块上。
zh-CN.interaction.friendEmpty: 背包中暂无可用于好友土地的特殊互动道具
zh-CN.interaction.confirmFriend.title: 对这位好友使用道具？
zh-CN.interaction.confirmFriend.body: 道具会按编号用到选中的地块上。
zh-CN.interaction.notEnough: 当前道具数量不够再选一块地
zh-CN.illustrated.remain: 距下一级还差 {count} 进度
zh-CN.illustrated.confirmBuy.title: 购买这颗种子？
zh-CN.illustrated.confirmBuy.body: 按当前标价购买所选数量。
zh-CN.bag.empty: 背包里没有可操作的物品。
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatchLock.title: 锁定所选物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatchLock.body: 将锁定 {count} 叠物品，之后不能出售。
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatchUnlock.title: 解锁所选物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatchUnlock.body: 将解锁 {count} 叠物品，之后可以出售。
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatch.title: 出售所选物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmBatch.body: 将出售 {count} 叠物品，换成金币。
zh-CN.bag.confirmLock.title: 锁定这叠物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmLock.body: 锁定后不能出售，自动出售也会跳过。
zh-CN.bag.confirmUnlock.title: 解锁这叠物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmSell.title: 出售这件物品？
zh-CN.bag.confirmSell.body: 出售后换成金币，这一叠都会卖掉。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmClaim.title: 领取这个成长任务？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmClaim.body: 只有已完成、已解锁且还没领取的任务会发出请求。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmDaily.title: 领取可领的每日任务？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmDaily.body: 只领取当前已经完成的每日任务，不会顺带领取成长任务。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmMall.title: 领取商城免费礼包？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmMall.body: 会领取当前可领的免费礼包。今天已经领过或没有可领礼包时不会再显示按钮。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmEmail.title: 现在检查邮箱？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmEmail.body: 不等到设定钟点，立刻领取当前可领的邮件。今天已经检查过就不再显示按钮。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmVip.title: 领取会员礼包？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmVip.body: 领取今天可领的会员礼包，以及 SVIP 商城里的免费礼包。未开通或今天没有礼包时按钮会消失。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmMonth.title: 领取月卡礼包？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmMonth.body: 领取今天可领的月卡奖励。未开通或今天已经领过时不再显示按钮。
zh-CN.gifts.confirmShare.title: 领取分享礼包？
zh-CN.gifts.confirmShare.body: 会上报今日分享并领取礼包。入口暂不可用时不会记成已领取。
zh-CN.gifts.retry: 最近检查 {time}，今日不再重试
zh-CN.gifts.mailEmptyAt: 检查时间 {time}，暂无可领取邮件
zh-CN.gifts.vipClosed: 未开通 QQ 会员或无每日礼包
zh-CN.gifts.vipEmpty: 已开通会员，当前没有可领取礼包
zh-CN.mall.title: 商城
zh-CN.mall.needRunning: 先启动这个账号，商品才会出现。
zh-CN.mall.svip: SVIP 生效中 · 剩余 {days} 天
zh-CN.mall.notSvip: 当前账号不是 SVIP，可浏览专属商品
zh-CN.mall.confirmBuy.title: 按这个价格购买？
zh-CN.mall.confirmBuy.body: 购买会扣掉标价。如果价格已经变了，购买会失败。
zh-CN.friends.title: 好友
zh-CN.friends.needRunning: 先启动这个账号，好友列表才会出现。
zh-CN.friends.qqSyncHint: QQ 新好友接口依赖已知 GID。系统会从最近访客补充，进入好友农场失败时会去掉失效 GID。
zh-CN.friends.gidPlaceholder: 一行一个，或用逗号、空格分隔
zh-CN.friends.gidMore: 还有更多 GID，请用搜索缩小范围
zh-CN.friends.confirmRemoveGid.title: 移出同步列表？
zh-CN.friends.confirmRemoveGid.body: 移出后，如果最近访客再次出现，这个 GID 仍可能被自动加回来。
zh-CN.friends.confirmRemoveUnsynced.title: 删除未同步的 GID？
zh-CN.friends.confirmRemoveUnsynced.body: 只删除当前好友列表里还没有的 GID。
zh-CN.friends.confirmBlock.title: 把这个好友加入黑名单？
zh-CN.friends.confirmBlock.body: 加入后，自动巡查会跳过这个好友。
zh-CN.friends.confirmUnblock.title: 把这个好友移出黑名单？
zh-CN.friends.confirmUnblock.body: 移出后，自动巡查可以再次访问这个好友。
zh-CN.friends.confirmBad.title: 给这个好友捣乱？
zh-CN.friends.confirmBad.body: 捣乱会在对方农场放虫和放草。
zh-CN.friends.confirmDelete.title: 删除这个好友？
zh-CN.friends.confirmDelete.body: 删除后，自动互动和自动通过申请都会跳过这个好友。
zh-CN.friends.noLands: 这个好友没有可展示的土地
zh-CN.analytics.title: 收益分析
zh-CN.analytics.empty: 游戏配置里还没有可比较的作物。
zh-CN.analytics.blacklistHint: 加入黑名单的作物在自动偷菜时会被跳过，不影响自己种植。
zh-CN.analytics.needAccount: 先选择一个账号，再编辑偷菜黑名单。
zh-CN.analytics.search: 按作物名称或种子编号查找
zh-CN.settings.title: 设置
zh-CN.settings.bagHint: 先按下面的顺序使用背包里的种子，不够时再用第二优先策略。
zh-CN.settings.landHint: 不选或全选都表示这种种子不限制土地。只勾选一部分时，它只种在这些土地上。
zh-CN.settings.bagEmpty: 当前没有可排序的背包种子
zh-CN.settings.acceptHint: 自动通过好友申请时，可以按等级和收偷比过滤。收偷比是偷菜份数除以收获份数。
zh-CN.settings.acceptUnlimited: 最低等级填 0 表示不限
zh-CN.settings.ranchBenefit: 自动领取牧场每日福利
zh-CN.settings.ranchFillCans: 自动把罐头加入罐头桶
zh-CN.settings.runtimeHint: 修改连接网关、登录平台和设备指纹。保存后应用到后续连接。
zh-CN.settings.resetRuntime.title: 重置运行环境？
zh-CN.settings.resetRuntime.body: 网关、版本和设备指纹会回到默认值。
zh-CN.offline.title: 下线提醒
zh-CN.offline.hint: 绑定 QQ 机器人后，账号下线、上线和授权失效时会自动推送。
zh-CN.offline.qqHint: 填写 AppID 和 AppSecret 后绑定，再用手机 QQ 给机器人发任意消息。
zh-CN.offline.scan: 请使用 QQ 扫描二维码完成绑定
zh-CN.offline.waiting: 等待 QQ 扫码并确认绑定
zh-CN.offline.waitingManual: 请用手机 QQ 打开该机器人并发送任意消息
zh-CN.offline.expired: 二维码已过期，请重新绑定
zh-CN.offline.unboundDone: QQ 机器人已解除绑定
zh-CN.offline.dingHint: Webhook 地址与 Access Token 二选一。机器人开启加签时填写密钥。
zh-CN.activities.title: 活动中心
zh-CN.activities.needRunning: 先启动这个账号，活动才会出现。
zh-CN.activities.confirmSummon.title: 召唤一场雷雨？
zh-CN.activities.confirmSummon.body: 会用掉一瓶雷雨召唤瓶。已经有特殊天气或没有瓶子时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmExchange.title: 兑换天气采集瓶？
zh-CN.activities.confirmExchange.body: 会消耗标出的货币。今天已经兑换过或余额不足时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.weatherDeferred: 还有好友要等巡查结束再查看
zh-CN.activities.confirmCollect.title: 在这个好友农场采集？
zh-CN.activities.confirmCollect.body: 会进入好友农场并消耗一瓶天气采集瓶。不是雷雨、这轮已经采过或没有瓶子时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmFrog.title: 对这个好友使用青蛙使坏瓶？
zh-CN.activities.confirmFrog.body: 会进入好友农场并消耗一瓶。没有可用瓶子时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmCloud.title: 对这个好友的作物使用乌云使坏瓶？
zh-CN.activities.confirmCloud.body: 会用在一块仍在生长、且还没有乌云的作物上。没有这样的作物时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmWeather.title: 点亮这个研究节点？
zh-CN.activities.confirmWeather.body: 会消耗雷电徽章。已经完成或徽章不足时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.mugeClosed: 活动尚未开始或已经结束
zh-CN.activities.hireEmpty: 现在没有可雇佣的好友
zh-CN.activities.confirmHire.title: 雇佣这位好友？
zh-CN.activities.confirmHire.body: 会按当前时长扣奶茶券。位置已满、对方不可雇、正在结算或余额不足时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmCraft.title: 用这叠果实制作奶茶？
zh-CN.activities.confirmCraft.body: 会用掉这一整叠未锁定的果实。锁定或数量变了不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmUpgrade.title: 升级店铺？
zh-CN.activities.confirmUpgrade.body: 会按当前等级升级。等级变了或条件不足时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmBoost.title: 用宣传喇叭爆单？
zh-CN.activities.confirmBoost.body: 会按所选份数消耗宣传喇叭。结算中或余额不足时不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmFund.title: 解锁成长基金？
zh-CN.activities.confirmFund.body: 会按当前标价扣除。费用变了不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmInteract.title: 做这项工作？
zh-CN.activities.confirmInteract.body: 会记在当前班次上。班次变了或次数用完不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.hireOffHint: 开启后好友无法雇佣你
zh-CN.activities.confirmRename.title: 修改店名？
zh-CN.activities.confirmRename.body: 冷却结束前不能再次修改。店名长度不对或和现在相同不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmHireOff.title: 保存躺平设置？
zh-CN.activities.confirmHireOff.body: 开启后好友无法雇佣你。关闭后可以再次被雇佣。
zh-CN.activities.openHint: 起一个 2 到 8 个字的店名就能开始营业，之后可以在店铺设置里修改。
zh-CN.activities.confirmOpen.title: 开始营业？
zh-CN.activities.confirmOpen.body: 店名确定后可以再改，修改有冷却。长度不对不会发出请求。
zh-CN.activities.confirmExchange.title: 兑换商品
zh-CN.activities.empty: 这一栏现在没有可操作的内容。
zh-CN.ranch.title: 牧场
zh-CN.ranch.needRunning: 先启动这个账号，牧场才会出现。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmAck.title: 解除扣费保护？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmAck.body: 请先在游戏里确认这次购买或升级是否已经生效。解除后，同一操作可以再次提交。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmCan.title: 按这个价格买罐头？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmCan.body: 付费商品会扣掉标价，免费商品不会扣费。如果商品或限购已经变化，操作会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmShare.title: 领取每日分享？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmShare.body: 领取前会上报今天的牧场分享。奖励对不上时，这次领取会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmFriend.title: 对这个好友牧场操作？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmFriend.body: 操作按当前栏舍状态执行。如果状态已经变化，操作会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmBook.title: 领取图鉴奖励？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmBook.body: 领取当前可领的图鉴奖励。如果奖励已经变化，领取会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmClaim.title: 领取这个任务？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmClaim.body: 领取按当前奖励结算。可以分享翻倍的任务会先上报分享。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmExchange.title: 按这个价格兑换？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmExchange.body: 兑换会扣掉标价。如果集市已经换一轮，兑换会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmCan.title: 把这罐罐头加进罐头桶？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmCan.body: 罐头会从背包扣掉，并增加对应罐头桶的时长。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmUpgrade.title: 开始升级这个设施？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmUpgrade.body: 升级会扣掉标价，并需要等待完成。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmRelease.title: 放生这只动物？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmRelease.body: 放生后动物会离开栏舍，已经产出的产物会保留。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmSell.title: 按这个价格出售？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmSell.body: 出售会扣掉这批产物。如果价格已经变了，出售会失败。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmPlace.title: 把这只幼崽放进窝棚？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmPlace.body: 放养会从背包扣掉一只幼崽。
zh-CN.ranch.confirmBuy.title: 按这个价格购买？
zh-CN.ranch.confirmBuy.body: 购买会扣掉标价。如果价格已经变了，购买会失败。
zh-CN.section.ranch: 牧场动物、牧草和每日福利会在引擎跟上 bot 之后在这里操作。

en-US.farm.confirmCare.body: Only selected crops that need water, weeding, debugging, or interaction cleanup are handled. A merged slave plot uses its master plot.
en-US.interaction.empty: No special interaction items can be used on your own farm.
en-US.interaction.needLands: Enter land numbers first, for example 1,2,3

en-US.bag.confirmBatchUnlock.body: This unlocks {count} stacks so they can be sold again.
en-US.bag.confirmBatch.title: Sell the selected items?
en-US.bag.waitCondition: Sell when the condition is met
en-US.bag.confirmLock.title: Lock this stack?
en-US.bag.confirmLock.body: A locked stack cannot be sold, and automatic selling skips it.
en-US.bag.confirmUnlock.title: Unlock this stack?
en-US.bag.confirmUnlock.body: Unlocking allows this stack to be sold again.
en-US.bag.confirmSell.title: Sell this item?
en-US.bag.confirmSell.body: Selling turns the whole stack into gold.
en-US.pets.protectLow: Less than a day of protection left
en-US.pets.feedNeedDog: Put a pet on the field first
en-US.pets.none: There is no pet data yet.
en-US.gifts.confirmClaim.title: Claim this growth task?
en-US.gifts.confirmClaim.body: Only a finished, unlocked task that has not been claimed is sent.
en-US.gifts.confirmDaily.title: Claim the ready daily tasks?
en-US.gifts.confirmDaily.body: This claims finished daily tasks only. Growth tasks stay where they are.
en-US.gifts.confirmMall.title: Claim the free mall gifts?
en-US.gifts.confirmMall.body: This claims the free gifts that are available. A finished day or an empty shelf hides the button.
en-US.gifts.confirmEmail.title: Check mail now?
en-US.gifts.confirmEmail.body: This claims ready mail without waiting for the scheduled hour. A finished check hides the button.
en-US.gifts.confirmVip.title: Claim the member gift?
en-US.gifts.confirmVip.body: This claims today's member gift and any free SVIP mall gift. No membership or no gift hides the button.
en-US.gifts.confirmMonth.title: Claim the monthly card?
en-US.gifts.confirmMonth.body: This claims today's monthly-card rewards. No card or a finished day hides the button.
en-US.gifts.confirmShare.title: Claim the share gift?
en-US.gifts.confirmShare.body: This reports today's share and claims the gift. An unavailable entry is not marked as claimed.
en-US.gifts.mailEmptyAt: Checked at {time}, no mail to claim
en-US.gifts.vipClosed: QQ membership or the daily gift is not available
en-US.gifts.vipEmpty: Membership is active, and there is no gift to claim
en-US.gifts.monthClosed: The month card is not purchased or has expired
en-US.gifts.empty: There is no gift status today.
en-US.mall.title: Mall
en-US.mall.needRunning: Start this account to see goods.
en-US.mall.notSvip: This account is not SVIP. Member goods stay visible.
en-US.mall.confirmBuy.title: Buy at this price?
en-US.mall.confirmBuy.body: Buying spends the listed price. If the price changed, the purchase fails.
en-US.friends.title: Friends
en-US.friends.needRunning: Start this account to see friends.
en-US.friends.qqSyncHint: QQ friend lookup needs known GIDs. Recent visitors are added, and a GID is removed when opening that farm fails.
en-US.friends.gidPlaceholder: One per line, or separate them with commas or spaces
en-US.friends.gidMore: More GIDs are hidden. Search to narrow the list
en-US.friends.confirmRemoveGid.title: Remove this GID from sync?
en-US.friends.confirmRemoveGid.body: If this visitor shows up again, the GID can be added back automatically.
en-US.friends.confirmRemoveUnsynced.title: Remove unsynced GIDs?
en-US.friends.confirmRemoveUnsynced.body: This removes only GIDs that are not in the current friend list.
en-US.friends.confirmBlock.title: Add this friend to the blacklist?
en-US.friends.confirmBlock.body: Automatic visits will skip this friend.
en-US.friends.confirmUnblock.title: Remove this friend from the blacklist?
en-US.friends.confirmUnblock.body: Automatic visits can include this friend again.
en-US.friends.confirmBad.title: Disturb this friend?
en-US.friends.confirmBad.body: Disturbing puts weeds and bugs on their farm.
en-US.friends.confirmDelete.title: Delete this friend?
en-US.friends.confirmDelete.body: Automatic visits and friend requests will skip this friend after deletion.
en-US.friends.noLands: This friend has no land to show
en-US.analytics.title: Analytics
en-US.analytics.empty: The game config has no crops to compare yet.
en-US.analytics.blacklistHint: Blacklisted crops are skipped when auto-stealing. Planting is unchanged.
en-US.analytics.needAccount: Choose an account before editing the steal blacklist.
en-US.analytics.search: Find a crop by name or seed id
en-US.settings.title: Settings
en-US.settings.bagHint: Use bag seeds in the order below first. When they run out, use the fallback strategy.
en-US.settings.landHint: Leave none or all land types selected to allow every land. A partial selection plants this seed only there.
en-US.settings.landOrphans: Restricted seeds not in the bag
en-US.settings.bagEmpty: No bag seeds can be ordered
en-US.settings.helpDog: Keep helping when the guard dog is full
en-US.settings.helpExpLimit: Skip help when experience is full
en-US.settings.acceptHint: Accepted requests can be filtered by level and by steal count divided by harvest count.
en-US.settings.mysteryBean: Mystery merchant may spend gold beans
en-US.settings.ranchGrassBuy: Buy grass when it runs low
en-US.settings.runtimeHint: Configure the gateway, login platform, and device profile used by new connections.
en-US.settings.resetRuntime.title: Reset the runtime environment?
en-US.settings.resetRuntime.body: The gateway, versions, and device profile return to their defaults.
en-US.offline.title: Offline alert
en-US.offline.hint: After the QQ bot is bound, the app pushes when an account goes offline, comes back, or its authorization expires.
en-US.offline.qqHint: Enter the AppID and AppSecret, start binding, then send the bot any message from mobile QQ.
en-US.offline.scan: Scan the QR code with QQ to finish binding
en-US.offline.waitingManual: Open this bot in mobile QQ and send it any message
en-US.offline.expired: The QR code expired. Start binding again
en-US.offline.dingHint: Provide either the webhook URL or the access token. Add the signing secret when the bot requires it.
en-US.offline.wechatMissing: The WeChat bot is not available yet.
en-US.activities.title: Activities
en-US.activities.needRunning: Start this account to see activities.
en-US.activities.confirmSummon.title: Summon a thunderstorm?
en-US.activities.confirmSummon.body: This uses one summon bottle. It is not sent while special weather is active or the bag is empty.
en-US.activities.confirmExchange.title: Exchange a weather collector?
en-US.activities.confirmExchange.body: This spends the shown currency. It is not sent after today's exchange or when the balance is short.
en-US.activities.weatherDeferred: More friends are waiting until patrol finishes
en-US.activities.confirmCollect.title: Collect at this friend's farm?
en-US.activities.confirmCollect.body: This enters the farm and uses one collector bottle. It is not sent outside a thunderstorm, after this storm was collected, or without a bottle.
en-US.activities.confirmFrog.title: Use a frog bottle on this friend?
en-US.activities.confirmFrog.body: This enters the farm and uses one bottle. It is not sent when no bottle is available.
en-US.activities.confirmCloud.title: Use a cloud bottle on this friend's crop?
en-US.activities.confirmCloud.body: This targets one growing crop that does not already have a cloud. It is not sent when no such crop exists.
en-US.activities.confirmWeather.title: Light this research node?
en-US.activities.confirmWeather.body: This spends lightning badges. Completed nodes and unaffordable nodes are not sent.
en-US.activities.mugeClosed: The event has not started or has ended
en-US.activities.confirmHire.title: Hire this friend?
en-US.activities.confirmHire.body: This spends milk-tea tokens for the selected duration. A full roster, an unavailable friend, settlement, or a short balance is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmCraft.title: Craft with this stack of fruit?
en-US.activities.confirmCraft.body: This uses the whole unlocked stack. Locked fruit or a changed count is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmUpgrade.title: Upgrade the shop?
en-US.activities.confirmUpgrade.body: This upgrades from the current level. A changed level or unmet requirement is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmBoost.title: Boost sales with horns?
en-US.activities.confirmBoost.body: This spends the selected number of horns. Settlement or a short balance is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmFund.title: Unlock the growth fund?
en-US.activities.confirmFund.body: This spends the current price. A changed price is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmInteract.title: Do this task?
en-US.activities.confirmInteract.body: This counts on the current shift. A changed shift or no chances left is not sent.
en-US.activities.hireOffHint: Friends cannot hire you while this is on
en-US.activities.confirmRename.title: Rename the shop?
en-US.activities.confirmRename.body: The name cannot change again until the cooldown ends. The wrong length or the current name is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmHireOff.title: Save the hire setting?
en-US.activities.confirmHireOff.body: While this is on, friends cannot hire you. Turning it off allows hiring again.
en-US.activities.openHint: A name of 2 to 8 characters starts the shop. You can rename it later in settings.
en-US.activities.confirmOpen.title: Open the shop?
en-US.activities.confirmOpen.body: The name can be changed later, with a cooldown. The wrong length is not sent.
en-US.activities.confirmExchange.title: Exchange
en-US.activities.confirmExchange.body: Exchange one at the shown price.
en-US.activities.empty: There is nothing to operate on this shelf.
en-US.ranch.title: Ranch
en-US.ranch.needRunning: Start this account to see the ranch.
en-US.ranch.confirmAck.title: Clear this hold?
en-US.ranch.confirmAck.body: Check in the game whether this purchase or upgrade already happened. After clearing, the same action can be sent again.
en-US.ranch.confirmCan.title: Buy this can at the listed price?
en-US.ranch.confirmCan.body: Paid goods spend the listed price. Free goods do not. If the goods or limit changed, it fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmShare.title: Claim the daily share?
en-US.ranch.confirmShare.body: Claiming reports today's ranch share first. If the reward does not match, it fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmFriend.title: Do this on the friend ranch?
en-US.ranch.confirmFriend.body: The action uses the current pen state. If that state changed, it fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmBook.title: Claim the illustrated reward?
en-US.ranch.confirmBook.body: This claims the reward that is ready now. If the reward changed, the claim fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmClaim.title: Claim this task?
en-US.ranch.confirmClaim.body: Claiming uses the current reward. A share-doubled task reports the share first.
en-US.ranch.confirmExchange.title: Exchange at this price?
en-US.ranch.confirmExchange.body: Exchanging spends the listed price. If the market round changed, it fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmCan.title: Add this can to a bucket?
en-US.ranch.confirmCan.body: The can leaves the bag and adds time to the matching bucket.
en-US.ranch.confirmUpgrade.title: Start upgrading this facility?
en-US.ranch.confirmUpgrade.body: Upgrading spends the listed price and then needs time to finish.
en-US.ranch.confirmRelease.title: Release this animal?
en-US.ranch.confirmRelease.body: The animal leaves the stall. Products already produced stay.
en-US.ranch.confirmSell.title: Sell at this price?
en-US.ranch.confirmSell.body: Selling removes this batch. If the price changed, the sale fails.
en-US.ranch.confirmPlace.title: Place this cub in a stall?
en-US.ranch.confirmPlace.body: Placing removes one cub from the bag.
en-US.ranch.autoPlace: Place in a stall after buying
en-US.ranch.confirmBuy.title: Buy at this price?
en-US.ranch.confirmBuy.body: Buying spends the listed price. If the price changed, the purchase fails.
en-US.section.ranch: Ranch animals, grass, and daily rewards will be operated here after the engine catches up with the bot.
en-US.section.activities: Milk tea, share rewards, and the solar calendar will be operated here.
en-US.section.mall: The regular mall, member mall, and mystery merchant will be purchased here.
